selection.edition: international Notion REST API v1 at api.notion.com
notes: Native recipe auth is type/scopes/setup only. Pinned open-connector notion at 33dd4ad6 supports oauth2 and api_key; this slice uses api_key with required secret notionToken and empty scopes.
Bearer notionToken plus Notion-Version 2026-03-11. GET/DELETE stay body-less. JSON Content-Type is set only when a request body is present.
Webhook operations keep sideEffect read. Origin 27 ops are retained; users.list is a GET action rather than a sync.

research.edition: international Notion REST API v1 at api.notion.com
research.searchCoverage: Official Notion REST at https://api.notion.com/v1. Internal integration tokens and OAuth access tokens use Authorization: Bearer. First-slice/deepen covers healthcheck, search, pages.get/create, databases.query, blocks.children.list, origin 27 ops rewritten as request-backed REST, data sources, file uploads (except multipart send), views, and inbound webhooks. Dated incident search on 2026-10-10 found no qualifying unresolved Notion API platform compromise. This is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-10-10 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
